articles.title: Crypto exchange HTX exits the UK after settling with the FCA
articles.snippet: The former Huobi exchange has stopped accepting deposits from British customers and agreed not to target them with crypto promotions.

articles.title: New quantum model slashes hardware needed to break bitcoin keys by 17 times
articles.snippet: Alice & Bob's new model reduces the hardware required for a potential attack, bringing it closer to reality and increasing pressure to adopt quantum-resistant security sooner.

articles.title: As $10 billion in bitcoin options near expiry, the tell is in the pricing
Bitcoin drops to $80,000 on Fed dissent, Samsung, Alphabet earnings; AI tokens slump
articles.snippet: Bitcoin fell 1.4% since midnight UTC to around $80,100 as disappointing reports from Samsung and Alphabet weighed on tech stocks. The Fed’s preferred inflation gauge is due later today.

articles.title: Solana wallet Solflare pledges to pay missed rewards on staked $160 million after validator goes offline
articles.snippet: About 1.56 million SOL sat on a validator that stopped earning, and the wallet still hasn’t named the firm that held its keys.
